pattern: a decision the user must make is asked in prose or a plain quote instead of as a question card
experience: An agent that needed the user to pick between two equally valid names asked as a plain quote instead of the card format, so the chat showed no answer controls and the user had to type a free-form reply.
rule: Ask decisions only the user can make with a question block: a bold `> **Qn · prompt**` line, a `>` line, then `> - option` lines.

pattern: a yes/no confirmation before a costly step is asked in prose

pattern: a pick-any option contains a comma, so the card shows as a plain quote
experience: An agent asked a pick-any question whose first option read "None, only <package>". Pick-any answers join options with ", ", so chat rejected the card and showed a plain quote with no answer controls.
rule: Pick-any options contain no commas: write "None (keep as is)", not "None, keep as is".

pattern: after the user answers one card, the agent asks the unanswered cards again or lists them as still open
experience: Clicking an answer on a card sends it at once and starts a turn. The agent then wrote that the other questions were still open and posted their cards a second time, while the user was still reading the first ones, which stay open in the thread.
rule: Act on the answers you have. Do not ask unanswered questions again or list them as still open: their cards stay open where you asked them.
